meta.title: Solti — Modular task-execution stack
meta.description: Supervise work in Tokio services, build agents for subprocess or container workloads, and add central control with Taskvisor, Solti SDK, and Podium.

hero.title: Compose systems.
hero.lede: From in-process supervision to agents and central control.

composition.title: One stack. Three explicit boundaries.
composition.lede: The stack separates system coordination, agent behavior, and in-process lifecycle. Each boundary has a distinct contract and a distinct integration model.

levels.title: Discover agents and reconcile rollouts.
levels.body: A Go service that manages task specifications, agent discovery, and per-agent rollout state. It applies desired specifications through versioned HTTP or gRPC agent APIs.

levels.title: Build your own task-execution agent.
levels.body: Composable Rust crates provide Task resources, workload routing, desired-state reconciliation, execution backends, and optional HTTP or gRPC APIs. Your team selects the components and owns configuration, deployment, and the final security boundary.

levels.title: Supervise Tokio work in-process.
levels.body: A Rust library for retries, backoff, attempt timeouts, cancellation, and graceful shutdown. Watched tasks return direct final outcomes; optional per-key admission can queue, replace, or reject competing work.
